We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template from previous step (template_search) to the given molecule. The previous step gave mapped_rxn and template_id 214705. We need to apply that template to the target molecule (initial_molecule). Use apply_template tool with molecule SMILES and template_id.

We have initial_molecule SMILES: O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O

We need to apply template 214705. Use apply_template.
